# Search ranking — map

## Destination

A ranking the team can explain to a customer in one sentence, backed by a vendor feed we do
not control.

## Decisions so far

- [01](issues/01-feed-shape.md) — adopt the flat feed shape; nested costs us nothing we use.
- [03](issues/03-cutoff-source.md) — the cutoff comes from the vendor, not from us.

## Fog

- Whether the vintage selector is needed at all.
- What we show on the day the vendor feed is late.
